description: Highlands and Islands Airports Limited (HIAL) Safeguarding Zones is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Highlands and Islands Airports Limited (HIAL) operate 11 regional airports. For each airport, they are required to have an active policy on aerodrome safeguarding. Safeguarding involves an assessment of any development or activity taking place in the area near to or surrounding our aerodromes. Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Human health and safety, Transport networks, zones. The portal shows 2024-11-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
